authenticity_review: The main trumpet inside the suitcase is rendered with high fidelity, showing correct brass material properties and structural coherence. However, the object to the right of the suitcase exhibits severe structural collapse; it appears as a nonsensical assembly of valve casings standing on thin tubes without a body or bell, indicating a significant generation artifact. This defect lowers the overall authenticity score despite the quality of the primary subject.

Structural collapse: The object to the right of the suitcase is a malformed fragment lacking a bell or body.
Spatial relationship failure: Suitcase is not 'under' three trumpets.
